_provenance: Match the reference photo's appearance statistics — silhouette (aspect/fill/cy/cover/trunk_w/fork) plus foliage colour moments (lum/lstd/grn_desc). The genome is the Construction template's render parameters; the measure is Julesz-descriptor distance to the real photo (baginton_oak). No taste: the photo is the reference. THE LOOP NEVER RENDERS — the witness is render_tree beside the photo.

walls.fidelity: The rendered tree's descriptor statistics MUST approach the photo's. fidelity = 1 - mean normalized descriptor distance; 1.0 is a perfect statistical match to THIS oak. The photo is the reference; no reference, no verdict.
walls.dist_lum: Foliage brightness MUST land near the photo's — the shade curve (shade_lo/shade_hi) and colour gain (bright) are the loci. Far off means the crown reads too dark or blown out.
walls.dist_aspect: The crown width:height MUST match the photo silhouette; rx/rz/droop are the loci.
walls.dist_cover: Canopy fill density MUST match — the density parameter is the locus; too low reads as sparse confetti, too high as a solid blob.
